objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Use the routing flaw to call a class of your choosing, run a command and read /ctf/flag.
hints: Without forced routing, the s parameter picks the module, controller and action. Read how ThinkPHP 5.0.20 validates the controller name.

steps.title: Identify the framework
steps.prompt: Which PHP framework, and which version, serves the site? (name and version)

steps.title: Find the parameter
steps.prompt: Which query parameter names the module, controller and action? (parameter name)

steps.title: Name the flaw
steps.prompt: What is missing from the validation of the controller name that lets it reach any class?

steps.title: Name the outcome
steps.prompt: What does the flaw give an attacker? (two words)
